vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.
💧 A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
👀 Someone asks the woman in her 20s, with a scarred cheek, the midwife a shop-talk question about midwife work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek).

👀 the woman in her 20s, with a scarred cheek, the midwife talks about wanting to belong somewhere the way people talk about weather — often, and with no plans to change it. The real wanting is somewhere they keep not looking.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek).
📋 A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Arlo, Nicole, Cheryl, Ethan and Ursula met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Arlo, Nicole, Cheryl, Ethan, Ursula are hurt.
🛡️ Arlo, Cheryl, Kairat, Ethan and Ursula met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Arlo, Cheryl, Kairat, Ethan, Ursula are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kairat just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ursula, Zoe, Brian and Ivy met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ursula, Zoe, Brian, Ivy are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pavel just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Ethan, Ursula, Zoe and Brian met them at the door — 4 put down. Ethan, Zoe, Brian are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
